claims.assertion: Mari quotes the First Directive as barring interference with non-interstellar cultures and introducing superior knowledge or technology.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says it forbids proof of Federation existence; exceptions allow correction of prior violations or contamination.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says a 2009 First Contact project used only human technology and no direct proof to assess public acceptance.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari argues the Directive is inconsistent because she believes the Federation already directs Earth society and technology.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says this makes the Federation complicit in Earth’s suffering.

review_flags: Federation policies and Earth-intervention allegations are reported by Mari Swaruu, not independently verified.
